ev.q: The gunplay is crisp and snappy with gun fights winning gun fights
you can choose between PvE or PvP depending on your playstyle
you can squad up with friends or run solo
It features a massive open world with a ton of ground to cover
you can spend your time enjoying the world and getting yourself immersed in it
Whether you want to fight other people or just loot and battle AI
The gun/gear customisation and the healing is very in depth
amazing environment that does a good job at building lore
looks amazing in terms of graphics
the games has great SFX and its really immersive
especially the slower, more deliberate style of play
I spend way too much time wandering around looking for one tiny item
The map is huge, but it also feels very dead
there's not much else to do than to level traders and fight players at the moment
you get a solid 150h of entertainment even before 0.5
The PvE is fun and at times challenging
